• Account ID, name, optional email and phone.

Account capabilities: ENTRANT, OWNER, and ADMIN; an account can hold multiple roles.
Preferred campsite tags and amenities, stored as sets without duplicates.
Notification Preference and palette preference, font and control-seze preferences
Does
• Validate that a non-removed account has a non-blank name and at least one role.
• Derive isActive from the absence of removal metadata.
Provide default settings and validate positive, finite size scales
Create a default entrant account.
Update profile, preferences, and settings while preserving unrelated fields.
Enable owner capability without granting ADMIN.
Reject changes to inactive accounts.
